name: MHaluBench
description: MHaluBench is a meta-evaluation benchmark designed to assess hallucination detection methods in multimodal large language models. It covers a broad range of hallucination categories and provides detailed granularity to facilitate evaluation advancements in hallucination detection.
reputation: A new multimodal hallucination-detection benchmark that is promising for meta-evaluation, but still early in community adoption.
notes: Includes a unified hallucination detection framework UniHD; addresses multiple hallucination categories with auxiliary tools.
